Powersets.name: Beast Mastery
Powersets.desc: Command a pack of fierce beasts to tear your enemies apart.

powers.name: Summon Wolves
powers.desc: Summon 1 to 3 Wolves depending on your level.

powers.name: Train Beasts
powers.desc: Provide your beasts with advanced combat training and abilities.

powers.name: Summon Lions
powers.desc: Summon 1 or 2 Lions depending on your level.

powers.name: Tame Beasts
powers.desc: Further upgrade your beasts with ultimate feral abilities.

powers.name: Summon Dire Wolf
powers.desc: Summon a powerful Alpha Dire Wolf to lead the pack.
